alt: A compact living interior photographed from an open entryway, showing cream walls, walnut shelving and furniture, afternoon light casting long shadows across pale flooring.
text:
watched a doorframe come away in a compact rental and the room suddenly read generous.

nothing changed but the sightline—cream walls, walnut, afternoon light finding its way through.

small rooms don't get bigger. they breathe.
